summary.verdict: Clean control. Every named site (Lynchburg, Erwin, Mount Vernon) confirmed in EPA FRS; DOE/NNSA contract record (Y-12 M&O $11B, Pantex M&O $6.6B, Portsmouth $4.5B, NFS uranium services $280M, N3B Los Alamos $51M) corroborates Naval Nuclear Propulsion + national-lab claims; counterparty HII discloses BWXT in 10-K exhibits; recent acquisitions (AOT, Kinectrics) reflected in cross-filer SEC record; USPTO shows 165 granted patents with deep nuclear coverage. No divergence found.
